gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.guh: Nyeg? I'm busy with my story. Come back in a bit!
gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.baltoguh: Sniff sniff... do you smell that too? Snow. Lots and lots of snow. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.mewtwo: I'm... twice as hungry. Which is pretty wahoog, actually.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.stitch626: Blub-nyeg! (626-guh looks at you with big eyes and quickly hides something behind his back.)
gui.guhs.timmerguh.past_niet: That roof fluff only fits on the see-through spots of Carpenter Guh's ear roof.
gui.guhs.timmerguh.nog: Pluff! %s more spots and the ear roof is done!
gui.guhs.timmerguh.vertel_het: %s lives in your house now! Hurry and tell Carpenter Guh, nyeg!
gui.guhs.timmerguh.alleen_kijken: Only the owner can change this house. But you're welcome to have a good look, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.niet_bouwen: Nomguh is so pretty and snowy, nyeg! No building or breaking here.
gui.guhs.balto.balto.naar_rosy: Go see Rosy at the little hospital: the white house with the pink heart. I can smell her sneezing, nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.balto.naar_boris: Boris always knows what to do. He's on our boat, just over there. Honk, he'll say.
gui.guhs.balto.balto.onderweg: Hup hup! We're on our way, follow the red posts!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.naar_rosy_kist: Quick, bring the medicine chest to Rosy! I'll run with you, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.klaar.0: Everyone calls me a hero now. I'm just... Baltoguh. But a WAHOOG one, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.klaar.1: Smell that? Hot cocoa on the town square. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.klaar.2: Half guh, half wolf. Just right the way I am.
gui.guhs.balto.balto.na_temmen.0: How's the Baltoguh at your place doing? Give him a pat from me, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.balto.na_temmen.1: I'm staying here on the boat, with Boris. But you're always welcome!
gui.guhs.balto.boris.nieuw: Honk! A new face! Go say hello to Baltoguh, da? He's out there on the ice.
gui.guhs.balto.boris.eerst_rosy: Rosy is sick, yes? Check on her at the little hospital first, little guh. Then we talk. Honk.
gui.guhs.balto.boris.ga: What are you waiting for? Baltoguh is ready by the boat. Honk honk!
gui.guhs.balto.boris.onderweg: Honk! Go, go! Follow the posts, da?
gui.guhs.balto.boris.naar_rosy: Not to me, to Rosy with that chest! Honk!
gui.guhs.balto.boris.klaar.0: Da, didn't I tell you? But maybe, just maybe... a Baltoguh can. Honk!
gui.guhs.balto.boris.klaar.1: Want flying lessons? Just kidding, honk. I hardly ever fly myself.
gui.guhs.balto.boris.klaar.2: A goose always has cold feet. That's why I stand on one leg. Honk.
gui.guhs.balto.boris.klaar.3: My little hat? From my granny. From the far east, da.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.begin.0: Nyeh-heh! I am Steele Mika, the fastest sled leader in all of Nomguh. And you are... nobody.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.begin.1: That little wolf guh? He couldn't even pull a tiny sled of nibbles. Nyeh-heh!
gui.guhs.balto.steele.begin.2: See my medal? Gold. Just like my fur. Well, almost.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.storm: To the mountain hut? In THIS storm? My gorgeous fur would get wet, nyeh. You do it.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.onderweg: I'd be much faster, of course. But I had to brush my fur.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.eer: Er... the chest? Well, I was obviously going to... never mind. Go on. Quick.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.klaar.0: Hmph. I could have done it too, nyeh-heh. But I was busy. With my fur.
gui.guhs.balto.steele.klaar.1: Want to race? Then you'll see who's really the fastest! (Nyeh.)
gui.guhs.balto.steele.klaar.2: That Baltoguh... eh, he's pretty okay. Don't tell anyone.
gui.guhs.balto.muk.0: Hi! I'm Muk, and that's Luk. Luk says: hi! (Luk waves.)
gui.guhs.balto.muk.1: We fish little guhfish out of the ice here. Luk catches more, but I count better!
gui.guhs.balto.muk.2: Brrr? Nope, we're never cold. We're polar bear guhs! Cuddle?
gui.guhs.balto.muk.klaar.0: You're a hero! Luk thinks so too. (Luk nods really hard.)
gui.guhs.balto.muk.klaar.1: Rosy is all better! Luk cried happy tears. Me too, a little.
gui.guhs.balto.muk.klaar.2: Want to come ice fishing sometime? Luk will lend you his little fishing rod!
gui.guhs.balto.luk.1: (Luk nods. Then he nods once more, just to be sure.)
gui.guhs.balto.luk.2: (Luk gives you a big polar bear hug. So warm!)
gui.guhs.balto.luk.3: (Luk proudly shows you his little fishing rod. There's a sock hanging on it.)
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.nieuw: Achoo! Oh, hi. Who are you? Are you Baltoguh's buddy? Achoo-nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.wachten.0: Achoo! Will you hurry back with the medicine? I'll wait here. In my little bed. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.wachten.1: Nurse Snuggles says I'm brave. Achoo! Are you brave too?
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.beter.0: I'm all better again! Can I ride on your shoulders? WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.beter.1: When I grow up, I'm going to be a sled guh. Just like Baltoguh!
gui.guhs.balto.rosy.beter.2: My little nose works again: I can smell hot cocoa! Nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.wolf.0: (The White Wolf Guh gives you a soft look. It makes your heart all warm.)
gui.guhs.balto.wolf.1: (She says nothing. But you know exactly what she means.)
gui.guhs.balto.wolf.2: (Snowflakes dance around her, like little stars.)
gui.guhs.balto.slee_niet: Nyeg... the sled can't leave right now (are you still busy, or is there no Nomguh nearby?).
gui.guhs.balto.moment.start: Go, Baltoguh! The trip to the mountain hut begins. Follow the red posts with the little lights!
gui.guhs.balto.moment.te_laat: Nyeg, once more! Too late... but Rosy is brave and will wait a little longer. Try again!
gui.guhs.balto.moment.gestopt: The trip has stopped. Baltoguh is waiting for you at the old boat. Shall we try again?
gui.guhs.balto.moment.storm_klaart_op: The storm is clearing... Baltoguh knows the way again! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.balto.held: ✿ %s is the Hero of Nomguh! Rosy is better, and all the guhs are singing. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.balto.getemd: Baltoguh is coming with you! He can sniff out the way to your house: press Sniff! in his guh menu!
gui.guhs.balto.hint.rosy: Go to Rosy at Nomguh's little hospital (the white house with the pink heart)
gui.guhs.balto.hint.boris: Ask Boris for advice: the goose on the old boat in the frozen bay
gui.guhs.balto.hint.start: Talk to Baltoguh at the old boat: off to the mountain hut!
gui.guhs.balto.hint.kist: Bring the medicine chest to Rosy at the little hospital
gui.guhs.balto.hint.tem: Baltoguh wants to come with you: talk to him at the old boat
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.1: By an old boat on the ice sits a gray guh with pointy wolf ears. He looks a little shy.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.2: Oh! Hi... I'm Baltoguh. Half guh, half wolf. The other guhs think I'm a little... weird. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.3: Nyeh-heh! Look, it's the little wolf guh! In Nomguh only REAL sled guhs pull the sled. Like ME!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.4: ...I'm sure he doesn't mean it. I think. But you know what? Something's wrong at the little hospital. I can smell it.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.ontmoet.5: The baby guhs are sick, and Rosy most of all. Will you go check on her? It's the white house with the pink heart.
gui.guhs.balto.optie.ontmoet: Of course! I'll go see Rosy.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.1: In the little hospital, the baby guhs lie in their cradles, sniffling softly. Rosy lies by the window.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.2: Achoo-nyeg! Oh, hi! I'm Rosy. I've got the nibble cough... My little nose is all red.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.3: The medicine is all gone, nyeg. The new medicine chest is in the mountain hut, high up on the Nomguh Peaks. And a snowstorm is coming...
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.4: Will you go get it? Then I'll get better and I can go sledding again! Achoo!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.rosy.5: Who knows the way through the storm? Maybe Boris, the goose on the old boat. He always knows what to do.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.1: Honk! Da, little guh... Rosy is sick, yes? I heard already. It made my feathers stand on end.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.2: Listen closely. The way to the mountain hut is marked with red posts with a little light. Follow the posts, da?
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.3: Along the way: Storm Valley, the Ice Bridge over the Gorge and Avalanche Mountain. Stay in the middle, and rest at the fire baskets.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.4: And take Baltoguh with you. Everyone thinks he's only half a guh... but his nose is the best in Nomguh.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.boris.5: Remember: a guh doesn't just think with his pawsies, but with his little heart too. Honk honk!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.start.1: Boris told you, huh? I'll pull the sled, you steer. Together we'll get the medicine for Rosy!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.berghut.1: The mountain hut! It's nice and warm inside. On the table sits the medicine chest, with a little pink heart on the lid.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.berghut.2: Sniff sniff... this is it! Hold on tight. Now hurry back to Rosy, before the storm gets even worse!
gui.guhs.balto.optie.berghut: Grab the medicine chest and head back!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.1: The storm is too strong. You can't see the posts anymore. Baltoguh sniffs... but all he smells is snow. He's lost the way. Nyeg...
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.2: I... I don't know anymore. Maybe they're right. Maybe I'm only half a guh.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.3: Then, all of a sudden, a white wolf guh stands among the snowflakes. She glows softly, like a little star, and looks at Baltoguh very kindly.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.4: An ordinary guh can't make this journey alone...
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.5: But maybe, just maybe... a Baltoguh can.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.wolf.6: I'm half guh... and half wolf. And that's just right. AWOOO-NYEG!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.aankomst.1: There's Nomguh! All the lights are on. The guhs are cheering by the stable.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.aankomst.2: Er... yes! Well done, really. I showed them the way, of course. With my... er... gorgeous fur. Nyeh-heh?
gui.guhs.balto.scene.aankomst.3: All the guhs look at Steele Mika... and then they start to giggle. Hee hee hee, nyeg! Even Steele Mika has to laugh a little.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.aankomst.4: One last bit! Bring the medicine chest to Rosy at the little hospital!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.1: You set the medicine chest next to Rosy's little bed. Nurse Snuggles gives every baby guh a spoonful of nibble syrup.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.2: Mmm, it tastes like strawberry cheese! ...Hey! My little nose works again! I'm better! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.3: You did it! No... WE did it. Together. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.4: Everyone in Nomguh now calls you the Hero of Nomguh. And Baltoguh? He'll never be the odd one out again.
gui.guhs.balto.scene.feest.5: Honk! What did I tell you, da? But maybe, just maybe... a Baltoguh can!
gui.guhs.balto.scene.tem.1: You know... I'd like to come with you. To your house. Is that okay? I can always sniff my way back, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.optie.tem_nee: Stay in Nomguh a little longer.
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.tooltip: Baltoguh sniffs out the way to your house (or your spawn point). Follow the glowing pawprints!
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.huisje: Sniff sniff! %1$s smells your house: %2$s more blocks to the %3$s. Follow the pawprints, nyeg!
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.spawn: Sniff sniff! %1$s smells your bed: %2$s more blocks to the %3$s. Follow the pawprints!
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.al_thuis.huisje: Sniff... %s wags: you're already at your house! Nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.al_thuis.spawn: Sniff... %s wags: you're already home! Nyeg.
gui.guhs.balto.snuffel.andere_wereld: Sniff sniff... %s can smell your home, but it's in another world. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.tocht.start: Baltoguh and the guh sled pups are ready. Through the snowstorm to the mountain hut, grab the medicine chest, then back to the little hospital as fast as you can. Rosy is counting on you!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.sprint.start: The Nomguh Sled Sprint (%s): to the mountain hut, around it, and back to the starting line. Faster than Steele Mika?
gui.guhs.baltoslee.besturing: W: hup hup, faster! · S: brake · A/D: steer · Hold Shift: stop. Follow Baltoguh's glowing sniff stars when you can't see a thing.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.gestopt: You stopped. The sled pups take you back to the stable. Nyeg, another time!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.rust.hint: A fire basket! Brake (S) and stand still for a bit to warm your pawsies.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.koud.uitleg: Watch the warmth bar: the pawsies get cold along the way. Stop at a fire basket at least once (S), or the sled pups start to dawdle. And steer into the gusts of wind!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.koud.bijna: The pawsies are getting cold! Warm them at a fire basket, nyeg.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.koud.traag: Brr, cold pawsies! The sled pups are dawdling. Stop at the next fire basket (S), nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.rust.tocht: Baltoguh and the sled pups warm their pawsies at the fire basket. Everyone gets a cuddle and a warm cheese nibble. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.rust.sprint: Warming up at the fire basket... warm paws are fast paws!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.ijsbrug: The ice bridge! Steer gently, it's slippery...
gui.guhs.baltoslee.plof.sub: Off the ice bridge into the soft snow. No harm done, try again!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.lawine.ontweken: Dodged the avalanche just in time! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.lawine.bedolven: Snowed in! The sled pups are digging you out...
gui.guhs.baltoslee.terug: The medicine chest is on the sled! Now back to the little hospital, and fast: you have %s.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.dieptepunt.sub: The storm is too strong. Where is Baltoguh?
gui.guhs.baltoslee.helder: The storm is calming down... you can see the lights of Nomguh again!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.aankomst.sub: %s to spare. The medicine is here!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.aankomst.uitleg: The little hospital! Baltoguh and the sled pups brought the medicine just in time. Rosy sneezes one more time, super cutely... and then she smiles. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.te_laat.uitleg: Nyeg, once more! Luckily Rosy is still sneezing away quite cheerfully, and the sled pups would love another lap. Just try again.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.sprint.keer: Around the mountain hut! Now back to the starting line!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.sprint.uitslag: Sled Sprint (%1$s): %2$s. You get %3$s sleigh bells. Avalanches dodged: %4$s, snowed in: %5$s.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.start: Nyeh-heh! I am the fastest sled leader in all of Nomguh. Try and keep up!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.ingehaald: Hey! That's... that's not allowed! Just you wait!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.eerst: FIRST! Naturally. Nyeh-heh! (He polishes his little cap.)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.gewonnen: Nyeh-heh! Told you: I'M the fastest! But... you did quite well. A little. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.verloren: What?! That was the wind! And the snow! And... my sled pups weren't wearing their socks!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.uitgelachen: All the guhs of Nomguh giggle sweetly. Steele Mika turns a little pink. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.al_onderweg: You're already on your way, aren't you? Nyeh-heh, hup hup!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.geen_route: Nyeg... the route is completely snowed under. Come back later.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.nog_niet: You? Race against ME? Nyeh-heh-heh! First go through the storm for real, like that Baltoguh. Then we'll talk. (My little shop is open, though.)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.welkom: Well, well. Brave enough to take on the champion? To the mountain hut, around it and back. Your best times: easy %1$s · medium %2$s · hard %3$s.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.steele.uitleg: Listen closely, because I'll only say this once. Hup-hup (W) is faster, brake (S), steer (A/D). Gusts of wind push you off the route: steer into them. Rumbling avalanche? Steer to the OTHER side of the route! The ice bridge is slippery: take it slow. And cold paws are slow paws: you have to stop at a fire basket at least once along the way. Not that it'll help, because I'M winning anyway. Nyeh-heh!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.vast: Snowed in! The sled pups are digging... woof-nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.berghut: The mountain hut: Baltoguh grabs the medicine chest... (%s)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.dieptepunt: The storm is too strong... where is Baltoguh? (%s)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.rust: Warm pawsies at the fire basket... (%s)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.lawine_rechts: ⚠ AVALANCHE from the left! Steer right ⇨
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.lawine_links: ⇦ Steer left! AVALANCHE from the right ⚠
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.lawine_veilig: Good, stay there! The avalanche is coming...
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.ijsbrug: Ice bridge: steer gently, don't go over the edge!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.vuurkorf: Fire basket! Brake (S) to warm up
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.diep: Deep snow! Back to the middle
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.koud: Cold pawsies: the pups are dawdling! Stop at a fire basket (S)
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.koud_bijna: The pawsies are getting cold! Warm them at a fire basket, nyeg
gui.guhs.baltoslee.hud.toetsen: W: hup hup · S: brake · A/D: steer · Hold Shift: stop
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.uitleg: Your very own snow sled! W: hup hup, S: brake, A/D: steer. The guh sled pups only run on snow and ice. Sneak + right-click to pick it up, and give them a cheese nibble now and then!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.geen_sneeuw: The sled pups want snow under their pawsies, nyeg!
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.niet_van_jou: This isn't your sled. The sled pups give you a sweet but stern look.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.knabbel: Woof-nyeg! The sled pups are super happy with their cheese nibble.
gui.guhs.baltoslee.eigen.geen_plek: The sled doesn't fit there. Find an open spot (preferably with snow)!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.telekinese.tooltip: Nibble telekinesis on or off: pulls cheese nibbles and items within 8 blocks toward him (and toward you)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.telekinese.aan: %s turns on nibble telekinesis: everything within 8 blocks floats over to you! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.telekinese.uit: %s takes a break from telekinesis. He'll just leave everything where it is, nyeg.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kopie.mokt: ...Nyeg. (The Guhtwo turns away and floats back and forth a little sadly.)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kopie.honger: A meal? For me? Double? ...My tummy says yes. Very loudly. GRRRUMBLE.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kopie.al_getemd: You already have a Guhtwo with you! I'll stay here, with Mewguh. Say hi from me. x2!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kopie.getemd_hier: Will you come visit again? Mewguh and I will save a double helping for you. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tem.vraag: You helped me. May I... come with you? Then I'll never be alone again. And I eat very neatly. Double neatly.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tem.gelukt: The Guhtwo floats happily over to you: he's yours now! He eats everything x2. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tem.later: Okay. I'll wait here. Floating. Hungry. (He winks.)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.1: Oh! A visitor! Welcome to my Clone Island! I'm Professor Nibbleclone. Don't mind the mess. Or the pink puddles.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.2: I had a dream: a guh who can eat TWICE as many cheese nibbles. So I tried to clone one, in my beautiful clone tank.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.3: But something went wrong. There was a BOOM, the tank cracked, and all my lab notes flew all over the lab! Now I don't even remember what happened exactly. Nyeg...
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.4: Will you find my six lab notes? They're everywhere: in my little office, in the dome hall, in the tower and by the jetty. Then we'll read together what happened!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.later: No problem! Meanwhile I'll go look for my glasses. They're probably crooked again. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.zoek: You have %1$s of the 6 lab notes! There are %2$s more somewhere on the island: look %3$s.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.1: All six! What a super sniffer you are. Let's read... hmm, day 45... BOOM... Oh! Now I remember!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.2: It didn't become a clone. It became something new: the Guhtwo! And he CAN eat twice as much. So my wish came true after all, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.3: But he got such a fright from the bang, and from his own hunger, that he went to sulk up in the arena. Poor guh.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.4: If we repair the clone tank, something lovely is bound to happen. Four parts are missing. They're in the parts crates: in the boathouse, in my little office, in the tower and in the stands.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.notities.5: Here, a present for my best lab assistant: a real trainer cap, with our very own logo! Install the parts at the tank in the dome hall.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.onderdelen: %1$s more parts for the clone tank. You have %2$s with you: install them at the tank in the dome hall!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.maaltijd: A DOUBLE helping for the big nibble bowl in the arena: %1$s more cheese nibbles and %2$s tasty snacks. Guhtwo and Mewguh are waiting!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.klaar: Just look at them, Guhtwo and Mewguh: best buddies! And you're the best lab assistant I've ever had. My glasses are even straight. Almost.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.prof.klaar_niet_getemd: Guhtwo is waiting for you up in the arena. I think he wants to ask you something... Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.al: You already have this lab note. There's a cheese nibble doodle on the back.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.alle: All six lab notes! Bring them to Professor Nibbleclone in his little office.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kist.gevonden: %s found! Install it at the clone tank in the dome hall.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kist.al: This crate is empty. You already have the part!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kist.nog_niet: A crate full of little screws and tubes... but which part do you need? Ask Professor Nibbleclone first.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.kist.klaar: An empty crate. The clone tank is already fully repaired, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.kapot: The clone tank is cracked. Pink nibble juice is dripping out. Professor Nibbleclone surely knows what needs fixing.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.mist: %s parts are still missing. Look for them in the parts crates on the island.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.heel: The clone tank bubbles cheerfully. Blub, blub, nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.scene.1: (The last part clicks into place. The tank fills with pink nibble juice. Blub... blub... BLUBBLUB!)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.scene.3: That... that's Mewguh! The very first pink guhling, they say. She came to see what all the bubbling was about!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.scene.4: Guhtwo is still sad. And what ALWAYS helps when you're sad? Exactly: a big nibble meal. A DOUBLE helping!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.tank.scene.5: Bring 32 cheese nibbles and 2 tasty snacks to the big nibble bowl in the arena. Here, put on this trainer outfit: then you'll look very official!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.schaal.nog_niet: A big empty bowl. Who could it be for? (Talk to Professor Nibbleclone first.)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.schaal.erin: In the bowl: %1$s of %2$s cheese nibbles and %3$s of %4$s snacks.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.schaal.meer: %1$s more cheese nibbles and %2$s snacks for a double helping!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.schaal.klaar: A bowl full of yum! Guhtwo and Mewguh have already feasted. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.1: Is that... all for me? A DOUBLE helping?
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.2: Hee hee! Together! Let's munch together!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.3: (Guhtwo and Mewguh munch away together at the big nibble bowl. Nibble nibble, x2! x2!)
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.4: I thought I was weird, because I want to eat twice as much. But eating twice as much... is actually pretty wahoog.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.scene.5: Mewguh says I'm her best buddy. And you're my buddy too. Will you... come see me in a bit? I want to ask you something. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.maal.cadeau: Giggling, Mewguh gives you a little balloon that looks just like her, and Guhtwo gives you a soft little tail. Click the Guhtwo in the arena!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.mew.zwaai: Mewguh does a little somersault in the air and waves at you. Hee hee, nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.niet_bouwen: No remodeling, nyeg! This is Professor Nibbleclone's lab (he can barely find his stuff as it is).
gui.guhs.mewtwo.klaar: The story of Clone Island is complete! The Guhtwo may now come with you (one time only). WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.1: Day 1. My big plan: a guh who can eat TWICE as many cheese nibbles. Why? Because I can. And because then I'll never have to clear away leftovers again. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.2: Day 12. The recipe: one tuft of guh fluff, a splash of pink nibble juice and lots and lots of love. The clone tank bubbles cheerfully. I've lost my glasses three times already.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.3: Day 30. A little pink guhling is floating around the island. She giggles every time I drop something (so, very often). She looks like a very old drawing... Mewguh?
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.4: Day 44. Oops. I accidentally put DOUBLE nibble juice in the tank. Now it's bubbling... purple? That wasn't in the recipe. Or was it? I can't find my recipe.
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.5: Day 45. BOOM! The tank cracked! Out stepped a light purple guh, with a tail with a little ball on the end and a tube in his neck. He looked at me and said: 'Nyeg...?'
gui.guhs.mewtwo.notitie.6: Day 46. He ate ALL the cheese nibbles on the island. Twice as many! My wish came true, WAHOOG! But he looks so sad. He sits up in the arena and doesn't want to see anyone.

gui.guhs.hemel.intro.1: Oh! A visitor, way up here in the clouds... Welcome to the Cloud Chapel, dear guh friend. Nyeg <3
gui.guhs.hemel.intro.2: I'm the Cloud Shepherd. I look after the Snuggleheart: that little pink heart over there, under its glass dome.
gui.guhs.hemel.intro.3: The Snuggleheart can bring guhs who went up to the clouds back home. With all their hearts, their faves, their clothes and their diary!
gui.guhs.hemel.intro.4: But... it's been asleep for a very long time. Zzz... nyeg. To make it beat again, I need three things.
gui.guhs.hemel.intro.5: A guh crystal, for the sparkle. A golden cheese nibble, for the warmth and the chonkiness. And a fluff feather from the Fluff Finches, for the softness.
gui.guhs.hemel.optie.wolkjes: Show me my guhs in the clouds
gui.guhs.hemel.waar: Guh crystals sparkle in the crystal caves of the Guhmension. Golden cheese nibbles fall from the sky during a Cheese Shower, and sometimes they're in the treasure of a cheese nibble nest. Fluff feathers are dropped by the Fluff Finches, in the Guh Fields and the Pink Puffs. Also have a peek in my heaven chest, in the garden!
gui.guhs.hemel.gebracht.kristal: A guh crystal! Look how it sparkles... The Snuggleheart flickers for a moment. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.hemel.gebracht.knabbel: A golden cheese nibble! Mmm, warm and chonky. The Snuggleheart turns a little pinker...
gui.guhs.hemel.gebracht.veertje: A fluff feather! So soft... Do you hear that? Very softly: ba... dum...
gui.guhs.hemel.nog_niks: Have you found anything yet? A guh crystal, a golden cheese nibble or a fluff feather... nyeg.
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.1: Look... look! The Snuggleheart is glowing...
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.2: Ba-dum... ba-dum... IT'S BEATING AGAIN! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.3: Thank you so much, dear guh friend. From now on the Snuggleheart can bring all your guhs back from the clouds. For free, as often as you like. Because no one gets forgotten. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.4: And for you: a golden halo and cloud wings, for one of your guhs. Then he'll look just like a little cloud guh!
gui.guhs.hemel.klopt.chat: The Snuggleheart is beating again! Click it to see your guhs in the clouds. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.hemel.hoeder.klaar: The Snuggleheart is beating, ba-dum ba-dum. %s of your guhs are up in the clouds. Do you want to see them?
gui.guhs.hemel.hoeder.klaar_leeg: The Snuggleheart is beating, ba-dum ba-dum. All your guhs are with you: no one in the clouds. Lovely, isn't it? Nyeg <3
gui.guhs.hemel.vertel: The Snuggleheart is made of all the cuddles ever given to a guh. That's why it never forgets anyone. When a tame guh goes up to the clouds, a little star stays behind, and his diary stays in your Guhdex. Here the Snuggleheart can bring him back, for free and as often as needed.
gui.guhs.hemel.slaapt: The Snuggleheart is still asleep... zzz. Ask the Cloud Shepherd how to wake it up.
gui.guhs.hemel.ster.leeft: %s has been back for ages! Keep this little star as a sweet memory. Nyeg <3
gui.guhs.hemel.ster.niet_van_jou: This little star belongs to someone else's guh... Give it to its owner, nyeg.
gui.guhs.hemel.ster.knuffel: You cuddle the memory of %s... Nyeg <3
gui.guhs.hemel.ster.leeg: A little star with no name... it still twinkles ever so sweetly.
gui.guhs.hemel.terug: WAHOOG! %s is back from the clouds! With all his hearts, faves and his diary. Nyeg <3
gui.guhs.hemel.terug.mislukt: Nyeg... that didn't work. Maybe he's already back?
gui.guhs.hemel.te_ver: Stand a little closer to the Snuggleheart.
gui.guhs.hemel.dood.hint: Somewhere high in the sky stands the Cloud Chapel. The Snuggleheart there can bring %s back...
gui.guhs.hemel.dood.hint_klopt: The Snuggleheart in the Cloud Chapel can bring %s back. For free, as often as you like.
gui.guhs.hemel.mijnguhs_hint: ♥ The Snuggleheart in the Cloud Chapel can bring him back (Super Compass, Tales tab).
gui.guhs.hemel.no_build: Nyeg! The Cloud Chapel is sacred: no breaking or building here.
gui.guhs.hemel.hart_heel: You can't break the Snuggleheart. It's made of cuddles!
gui.guhs.hemel.scherm.sub: Who do you want to bring back from the clouds?
gui.guhs.hemel.scherm.leeg: All your guhs are here, with you.
gui.guhs.hemel.scherm.leeg2: No one in the clouds. Nyeg <3
gui.guhs.hemel.scherm.vandaag: Went up to the clouds today
gui.guhs.hemel.scherm.gratis: Free, as often as you like
gui.guhs.hemel.nodig.1: The Snuggleheart still needs: a guh crystal. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.hemel.nodig.2: The Snuggleheart still needs: a golden cheese nibble. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.hemel.nodig.3: The Snuggleheart still needs: a guh crystal and a golden cheese nibble. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.hemel.nodig.4: The Snuggleheart still needs: a fluff feather. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.hemel.nodig.5: The Snuggleheart still needs: a guh crystal and a fluff feather. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.hemel.nodig.6: The Snuggleheart still needs: a golden cheese nibble and a fluff feather. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.hemel.nodig.7: The Snuggleheart still needs: a guh crystal, a golden cheese nibble and a fluff feather. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.scanner.meting.4: Too chonky? No such thing. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.scanner.uitslag: ✦ Chonkiness Scanner: the CHONKINESS LEVEL of %s is... INCALCULABLY WAHOOG! The meter went off the charts. ✦
gui.guhs.guhwaii.scanner.leeg: Put a guh on the scanner first! (Or hold a picked-up guh, or bring a guh along.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.scanner.bezig: The scanner is still measuring... beep beep!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.beschermd: This is Lilo-guh and Nani-guh's house (or 626's capsule): no building or breaking here, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ukelele.tooltip: 626-guh grabs his ukulele and plays a song: "Aloha, nyeg!"
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ukelele.niet_nu: Blub? (He can't play right now. Later!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.kokos_onrijp: This coconut is still green. Wait a little longer, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.eitjes_uit: Crack, crack! Tiny little Shellies are hatching from the eggs. Welcome to Guhwai'i!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.intro.1: Aloha! I'm Lilo-guh. Welcome to Guhwai'i! Want a coconut? No? Okay, then I'll eat it myself. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.intro.2: Lilo-guh! Don't talk with your mouth full. Hello, I'm Nani-guh, her big sister.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.intro.3: Last night I saw a shooting star! It fell on top of the hill, with a really loud noise. BOOM!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.intro.4: Nani-guh won't let me go there alone. Will you go take a look? Bring a guh along, that's safer!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.capsule: Have you found the shooting star yet? It's on top of the hill! (Your Super Compass knows the way: Tales tab.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.1: A capsule?! With a weird meter inside? And it was... empty? Then I know where that little blue guh came from!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.2: This morning there was a little blue guh with four paws and big ears at the shelter. His name is Experiment 626!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.3: Lilo-guh... the shelter said he's 'a little wild'. Are you sure?
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.4: Super sure! Nobody wants him, so that means I have to have him. From now on his name is 626-guh. Come on, 626-guh!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.5: Blub-nyeg! (626-guh runs inside, pulls all the cushions off the couch and knocks over the sand bucket.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.adoptie.6: Oh no, there's mess everywhere! Nothing broken, luckily... Will you help me tidy up? I'm in the kitchen.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.opruimen: 626-guh doesn't mean it, he just doesn't know any better! Will you help Nani-guh tidy up? (%s of %s)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.lief: 626-guh has to learn to be sweet. Show him what sweet is: give him something sweet! He's outside by the shelter.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.klaar.1: 626-guh is the sweetest guh on the whole island. Don't you think? Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.klaar.2: Have you tried the Chonkiness Scanner yet? Every guh is INCALCULABLY WAHOOG. Every single one!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.klaar.3: You know what's the best? Having someone to drink coconut milk with.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lilo.klaar.4: You can go surfing on the other side of the island! Will you come too? I'm there a lot!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.1: Look at that! 626-guh got a coconut, a flower and cheese nibbles. And he didn't knock anything over!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.2: Blub... sweet? 626... sweet? (He carefully hugs Lilo-guh with all four of his little arms.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.3: They said he was made to be TOO CHONKY. But you know what? A guh can never be too chonky!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.citaat: Ohana means family. Family means nobody gets left behind... or forgotten. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.4: And now you're part of it too. Thank you, really. Here, something for you: the poster, a ukulele and our island clothes!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.ohana.5: Aloha... NYEG! (626-guh waves with four little arms at once.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.begin: Hi, I'm Nani-guh. Will you keep an eye on Lilo-guh for me? She always has these... ideas.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.opruimen: Will you help? Click the mess away: cushion feathers, a tipped-over bucket, coconut shells... %s to go!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.opgeruimd: All neat again! Nothing's broken, luckily. But 626-guh really does need to learn to be sweet...
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.lief: 626-guh loves coconuts, flowers and of course cheese nibbles. Who doesn't?
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.ohana: I think Lilo-guh wants to tell you something. Off you go!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.klaar.1: Ever since 626-guh got here, it's never quiet anymore. But it is cozy. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhwaii.nani.klaar.2: Want some coconut milk? A coconut and a glass bottle, that's all you need!
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.vreemd: Blub-nyeg! (A little blue guh with four little arms looks at you with big eyes and quickly hides something behind his back.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.asiel: Blub? (He presses his nose against the shelter fence. He wants a home so badly.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.rommel: Blub-blub... (He looks at the mess a little guiltily. Just a teeny bit.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.ohana: Ohana? (He tugs at your sleeve, toward Lilo-guh!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.wat_lief: Blub? (He wants something sweet: a coconut, a pink hibiscus or cheese nibbles.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.al_gehad: Nyeg! (He already has that one. He wants something else sweet!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.meer_knabbels: Blub! (He points at your cheese nibbles and holds up %s little fingers. With all his little hands.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.gave.kokos: Crack, slurp! (626-guh drinks the coconut empty and hands you back half the shell. As a present.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.gave.bloem: Ooh... (He very carefully tucks the pink hibiscus behind his big ear. He's blushing!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.gave.knabbels: NOM NOM NOM! (He eats the cheese nibbles with four little hands at once. That's pretty wahoog.)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.lief_klaar: 626... sweet! (He gives you a hug. A super soft one. Now hurry to Lilo-guh!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.getemd: Aloha, nyeg! (626-guh jumps into your arms. He's coming home with you!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.al_thuis: Aloha! (This 626-guh stays with Lilo-guh. Yours is waiting for you at home!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.626.knabbel: Blub? (Give him a cheese nibble, and he'll come with you!)
gui.guhs.guhwaii.lijstje: 626-guh wants something sweet: %s a coconut  %s a pink hibiscus  %s %s cheese nibbles

gui.guhs.guhwaii.hint.capsule_gevonden: A capsule! With a weird meter inside... and it's empty. Tell Lilo-guh!

gui.guhs.guhwaii.hint.ohana: 626-guh has become sweet! Go back to Lilo-guh.

gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.waar.4: At your Guh House at home, and then Carpenter Guh in Snuggledale

gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.stap.1: Visit Rosy at the little hospital

gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.2: Ask Boris the goose for advice. Honk!

gui.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo.waar.0: Professor Nibbleclone in his little office on Clone Island (Deep Guh Sea)
gui.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo.waar.1: All over Clone Island; then the professor's little office
gui.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo.waar.2: The parts crates on the island, and the clone tank in the dome hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo.waar.2_inbouwen: The clone tank in the dome hall of Clone Island

gui.guhs.verhalen.hemel.uitleg: The Snuggleheart sleeps in the Cloud Chapel. Wake it up, and you can bring guhs back from the clouds.
gui.guhs.verhalen.hemel.nu.0: Find the Cloud Chapel and talk to the Cloud Shepherd.
gui.guhs.verhalen.hemel.nu.1: Bring the Cloud Shepherd a guh crystal, a golden cheese nibble and a fluff feather (one at a time is fine too).
gui.guhs.verhalen.hemel.nu.klaar: The Snuggleheart is beating again! Click it to bring a guh back from the clouds.
gui.guhs.verhalen.hemel.waar.0: The Cloud Shepherd in the Cloud Chapel, a little cloud temple on a floating islet (Guh Fields, Guh Meadows...)
gui.guhs.verhalen.hemel.waar.1: Talk to the Cloud Shepherd in the Cloud Chapel
gui.guhs.verhalen.hemel.waar.klaar: The Snuggleheart in any Cloud Chapel
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.uitleg: A star fell on the hill of Guhwai'i... and inside was a very naughty little blue guh: 626-guh!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.nu.0: Talk to Lilo-guh in the stilt house on the beach.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.nu.1: Find the shooting star on top of the island's hill: the crashed capsule.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.nu.2: You found the capsule! Tell Lilo-guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.nu.3: Help Nani-guh tidy up: click 626's bits of mess in and around the stilt house.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.nu.4: Give 626-guh something sweet: a coconut, a pink hibiscus and 8 cheese nibbles (right-click him with them).
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.nu.5: 626-guh has become sweet! Go back to Lilo-guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.nu.klaar: Ohana means family. And you never leave family behind, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.nu.klaar_tem: The story is done! Give 626-guh a cheese nibble by the shelter: then he'll come with you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.waar.0: Lilo-guh in Lilo and Nani's Stilt House (Guhwai'i)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.waar.1: The Crashed Capsule on the hill of Guhwai'i (Super Compass: Tales tab)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.waar.2: Talk to Lilo-guh in the stilt house on Guhwai'i
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.waar.3: In and around Lilo and Nani's Stilt House (Guhwai'i)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.waar.4: 626-guh outside the guh shelter next to the stilt house
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.waar.5: Talk to Lilo-guh in the stilt house on Guhwai'i

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwaii.waar.klaar_tem: 626-guh by the guh shelter next to the stilt house (Guhwai'i)
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.uitleg: Mother Chonky misses her baby guh Guhbert. The Mikas took him!
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.stap.1: Free Guhbert from the Mika Camp
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.nu.0: Talk to Mother Chonky in her shrine.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.nu.1: Win rock-paper-scissors against the Mika Boss 3 times in a row. Psst: CHONK always wins!
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.nu.2: Find the Lost Guh Cake at a Guh Picnic.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.nu.3: Bring Mother Chonky the Lost Guh Cake and 3 guh balloons.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.nu.klaar: Mother Chonky gobbled you up, and now you have your own guhbelly! The Dentist Guh makes it bigger.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.waar.0: Mother Chonky in the Chonky Shrine (Guhmension)
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.waar.1: The Mika Boss in the Mika Camp (follow your Mika Tracker Compass)
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.waar.2: A Guh Picnic in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.waar.3: Talk to Mother Chonky in the Chonky Shrine
gui.guhs.verhalen.vadsig.waar.klaar: The Dentist Guh in your guhbelly
gui.guhs.verhalen.slee.uitleg: The old Sled Guh would so love to go sledding one more time, but his sled is broken.
gui.guhs.verhalen.slee.nu.0: Talk to the Sled Guh in his Sled Hut.
gui.guhs.verhalen.slee.nu.1: Bring a sled runner (Guh Caves), a guh jingle bell (guh villages) and a pink ribbon (tailor).
gui.guhs.verhalen.slee.nu.klaar: The sled is fixed, and you got your own Guh Sled and the sled builder's book. Whoosh!
gui.guhs.verhalen.slee.waar.0: The Sled Guh in the Sled Hut (Guh Peaks)
gui.guhs.verhalen.slee.waar.1: Talk to the Sled Guh in the Sled Hut (Guh Peaks)
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.uitleg: Mayor Chonkworth wants to throw the coziest party ever. Will you help with the six party chores?
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.nu.0: Talk to Mayor Chonkworth on the town hall steps: you'll get a Cozyfest List.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.nu.1: Do all the party chores on your list and bring them to the mayor. Next: %s. Watch out for Crumb Mika!
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.nu.2: Everything's delivered! Talk to the mayor: let the party begin!
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.nu.klaar: What a cozy party! You're now the Snuggle Mayor. Every season there's a new season party.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.waar.0: Mayor Chonkworth at Snuggledale's town hall (Snuggledale biome)
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.waar.1: The Snuggledale Games, then Mayor Chonkworth at the town hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.waar.2: Mayor Chonkworth at Snuggledale's town hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.waar.klaar: Mayor Chonkworth, for a season party
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.uitleg: Overlord Mika has captured the Hungry Enderguh in the Guh End. King Guh is asking for your help!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.nu.0: Make friends with the Gatekeepers (sit or say "nyeg") and talk to King Guh on his throne.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.nu.1: Find a Mika Tear: Mikas sometimes drop one (or win against the Mika Boss).
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.nu.2: Make an Eye of Chonky (guh crystal + cheese nibbles + Mika Tear) and throw it in the Guhmension.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.nu.3: Follow the eyes to the Nibble Cellar, deep underground.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.nu.4: Fill all twelve portal frames with an Eye of Chonky: the portal opens!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.nu.5: Jump through the portal into the Guh End.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.nu.6: Smash the crystals, feed the Hungry Enderguh and defeat Overlord Mika!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.nu.7: Tell King Guh you won: he'll knight you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.nu.klaar: You're a Knight of the King Guh! You can always defeat Overlord Mika again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.waar.0: King Guh in the Guh Castle (very far away in the Guhmension)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.waar.1: Mikas in the Guhmension, or the Mika Boss in the Mika Camp
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.waar.2: At the workbench, then throw it in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.waar.3: The Nibble Cellar, underground in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.waar.4: The portal in the Nibble Cellar
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.waar.5: The portal in the Nibble Cellar
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.waar.7: Talk to King Guh in the Guh Castle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guheinde.waar.klaar: The Guh End, via the Nibble Cellar
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.uitleg: The Grill Guh dreams of the Barbecuether. Build a grill coal portal together and light it!
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.nu.0: Talk to the Grill Guh by the big Barbecue Pit.
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.nu.1: Make grill coal (cheese sauce over a block of coal) and build a grill coal frame by the Grill Guh. Then talk to him again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.nu.2: Get a fire starter cube: the Mikas in a Mika Camp drop one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.nu.3: Light the grill coal frame with the fire starter cube. Fwoomph!
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.nu.klaar: The portal to the Barbecuether is burning! The Grill Guh gave you his secret recipe, and his shop is open.
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.waar.0: The Grill Guh by the big Barbecue Pit (Guhmension or Barbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.waar.1: By the Grill Guh's Barbecue Pit
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.waar.2: A Mika Camp in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.waar.3: The grill coal frame by the Grill Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.waar.klaar: The Grill Guh and the Barbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_brandweer.uitle: Help Fire Chief Splashguh: the marshmallow fires are flaring up and a little guh is stuck in a tree!
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_brandweer.nu.0: Talk to Fire Chief Splashguh: you'll get a guh fire hose.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_brandweer.nu.1: Put out all the marshmallow fires with the guh fire hose. Pssssh!
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_brandweer.nu.2: Rescue the little guh from the tree (right-click it).
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_brandweer.nu.kl: Firefighting hero! Your guhs now wear a firefighter helmet and jacket.

gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_politie.uitleg: Inspector Wahoogsby is looking for the Nibble Thief. Follow the little pawprints!
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_politie.nu.0: Talk to Inspector Wahoogsby at the little police station.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_politie.nu.1: Follow the little pawprints to the nibble loot and right-click the sack.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_politie.nu.klaa: Case closed! Your guhs now wear a police cap and uniform.

gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_apotheek.uitleg: Sniffles has a cold! Doctor Sniffleguh needs a cheese milk potion.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_apotheek.nu.0: Talk to Doctor Sniffleguh at the little pharmacy: you'll get cheese milk.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_apotheek.nu.1: Pick 3 sniffle herbs, make a cheese milk potion in the mixing cauldron and give it to Sniffles.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_apotheek.nu.2: Sniffles is better! Tell Doctor Sniffleguh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_apotheek.nu.kla: Achoo-gone! Your guhs now wear a doctor's coat and a stethoscope.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_apotheek.waar.0: The little pharmacy on Snuggledale's Career Street
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_apotheek.waar.1: Around the little pharmacy in Snuggledale (the mixing cauldron is inside)
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_apotheek.waar.2: Doctor Sniffleguh at the little pharmacy in Snuggledale
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_bouw.uitleg: Bob the Guhbuilder is building a house, but the roof isn't finished yet. Can we fix it? Nyeg, we can!
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_bouw.nu.1: Bring Bob 16 planks (any wood) and 8 cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_bouw.nu.2: Fill every ghostly spot of the roof with the roof tiles.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_bouw.nu.klaar: The roof is done! Your guhs now wear a hard hat and a safety vest.
gui.guhs.verhalen.beroep_bouw.waar.0: Bob the Guhbuilder in a Guh Village (Guhmension)
